script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'no', h.stock_movement_no, 'status', h.item_assembly_status, 'item_id', h.item_id,
       'item_uom', CAST(h.item_uom AS CHAR), 'organization_id', h.organization_id, 'source_so_id', h.source_so_id,
       'source_so_line_id', h.source_so_line_id, 'source_so_context_json', h.source_so_context_json,
       'old_line_live', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order_axszx8cj_sub x
                          WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND h.source_so_line_id REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$'
                            AND x.id = CAST(h.source_so_line_id AS UNSIGNED))) AS j
  FROM sm_item_assembly h
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_RLguard.data.ia}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
       'line', IF(l.id IS NULL, NULL, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'sales_order_id', CAST(l.sales_order_id AS CHAR),
         'item_name', l.item_name, 'so_quantity', CAST(l.so_quantity AS CHAR), 'so_item_uom', CAST(l.so_item_uom AS CHAR),
         'delivered_qty', CAST(l.delivered_qty AS CHAR), 'line_status', l.line_status, 'is_deleted', l.is_deleted, 'line_index', l.line_index,
         'plant_id', CAST(l.plant_id AS CHAR))),
       'header', IF(s.id IS NULL, NULL, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'so_no', s.so_no, 'so_status', s.so_status,
         'organization_id', s.organization_id, 'customer_id', CAST(s.customer_name AS CHAR), 'customer_name', c.customer_com_name,
         'is_deleted', s.is_deleted))) AS j
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) d
  LEFT JOIN sales_order_axszx8cj_sub l ON l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.id = {{node:code_node_RLguard.data.line}}
  LEFT JOIN sales_order s ON s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.tenantId}}' AND s.id = COALESCE(l.sales_order_id, 0)
  LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.tenantId}}' AND CAST(c.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = s.customer_name

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('member', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blade_dept p
          WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND {{node:code_node_RLguard.data.org}} > 0 AND (p.id = {{node:code_node_RLguard.data.org}} OR FIND_IN_SET('{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.org}}',
		p.ancestors) > 0)
            AND FIND_IN_SET(CAST(p.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci,
                  (SELECT COALESCE(u.dept_id, '') FROM blade_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RLguard.data.tenantId}}' AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.id = {{node:code_node_RLguard.data.uid}} LIMIT 1)) > 0)) AS j
